Media and Broadcasting

# Know your audience

In a rapidly evolving media landscape, guesswork is a liability. The Media Technology Monitor (MTM) is an investment in unparalleled evidence-based market intelligence that will sharpen your strategy, drive audience engagement and secure your competitive edge.

## Get ahead of changes

Attention fragmentation is real – know where your audience is now, where it will be next and who you may not be reaching yet.

Platform Diversification

Meet your audience where they're at.

Canadians no longer live on just one platform—they stream on one, scroll on another, and stay connected on a third. MTM tracks the full media diet across all screens, platforms, and services to capture real-world insights for any target audience

Top Social Media Platforms

![Top Social Media Platforms](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/solutions/media/insight-1.svg)

Market Intelligence

Stop marketing to the 'average' Canadian.

Not all Canadians share the same media habits—from streaming and podcasts to device ownership. MTM provides high-definition visibility, filtering data by ethnicity, age, income, and family structure so you connect exactly when and how your audience needs you.

FAST Channel Viewership

![FAST Channel Viewership](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/solutions/media/insight-2.svg)

## Tools that empower you

### Analytic Tools

Query MTM's full dataset by platform, region, language, and demographic. Build custom cross-tabs in minutes, track adoption curves over time, and model where your audience will be in three years — all at the click of a button.

Data Analysis

Trending

Forecasting

[Learn more](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/tools/analytic-tools/)

### Census Tools

Map your audience at the postal code level. Identify underserved communities, size local markets, and benchmark your reach against the national population — all from a single dashboard sourced directly from Statistics Canada census data.

Snapshot

Explorer

Compare

3 more

[Learn more](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/tools/census-tool/)

## How MTM fits the way you work already

You don't open a research tool and start clicking. You have a business question. MTM is built to answer it, at every stage of your workflow.

01 Query

Select your variables

Start with a question — platform reach, time spent, device ownership, service provider. Pull exactly the variables you need from and the MTM lets you build your view in minutes.

02 Customize

Build your cross-tab or chart

Drag variables into rows and columns. Filter by region, language, age or strategic target group. Every output is yours to configure - no fixed tables, no waiting.

03 Export

Export for your client

Download your analysis in presentation-ready formats. Drop it straight into a deck, a brief, or a regulatory submission - formatted and ready to go.

## MTM in Action for Media Teams

Learn how your organization can use the MTM to grow or maintain your key audiences.

Use Case

Understanding the most effective way to promote a new TV show to affluent Baby Boomers.

How to leverage this

Read our dedicated Baby Boomers report to learn where they are concentrating their current viewing, which are most exposed to advertising and whether traditional TV remains king for this audience.

How to leverage this
